unitTitle: Adjectives/Order of Adjectives/Comparisons - Expressing Certainty - Will

pairsWith.noteUz: Qiyoslash shakli va ishlatilishi, must/can't (ishonch), will (bashorat) nazariyasi + birinchi mashq.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 3-UNIT NAZARIYA DAVOMI + 1-MAShQ (15-bet, PDF 14). Yuqorida o'ngda ko'k '3'. Och pushti ramka, ikki ustun.

CHAP USTUN:
'Form': • One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st to form their comparative and superlative forms. 'large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in), cheap - cheaper (than) - the cheapest (of/in)' • One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants, double the last consonant and add -er/-est. 'big - bigger (than) - the biggest (of/in)' • Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y, drop -y and add -ier/-iest. 'heavy - heavier (than) - the heaviest (of/in)' • Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most. 'careful - more careful (than) - the most careful (of/in)' • Irregular adjectives have their own individual comparative and superlative forms.
'Note': • We often make comparisons using than. • We use the before the superlative form.
'Use': • We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places, etc. We usually use than with comparative adjectives. 'Sue's skirt is longer than Mary's.'

O'NG USTUN:
• We use the superlative form to compare a person, thing or place with the whole group they belong to. We use the ... of/in with superlative adjectives. 'Pluto is the coldest planet in our solar system.' • We use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, things or places are/are not similar. 'Tom is as tall as Peter.' • We use less + adjective + than for two persons, things or places. 'The green jacket is less expensive than the yellow jacket.' • We use much + comparative form + than for two persons, things or places. 'This tie is much longer than that one.'
'Expressing Certainty' - 'Must - Can't': • We use must + infinitive without to to say that something is logically true. 'They look the same. They must be twins.' • We use can't + infinitive without to to say that something is logically untrue. 'This book can't be his. He doesn't like detective stories.'
'Will (predictions)': • We use will + infinitive without to to make predictions based on what we believe or think. We usually use will with the verbs think, and expect, and the adverb probably, etc. 'I think he will help me.'

PASTDA - 'Comparisons':
1) 'Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the adjectives in brackets, as in the example.' 1 My house is bigger (big) than yours. 2 Peter is not as ...... (tall) as Sally. 3 Los Angeles is ...... (polluted) than Vancouver. 4 That was the ...... (bad) meal I've ever eaten. 5 Our house is less ...... (modern) than yours. 6 Celine Dion is very ...... (famous). 7 They are as ...... (rich) as the Browns. 8 The Danube is the ...... (beautiful) river in Europe. 9 This sleeping bag is ...... (comfortable) than that one. 10 Mary's dress is ...... (expensive) than Diana's. 11 The red hat is much ...... (cheap) than the blue one. 12 Asia is the ...... (large) continent in the world.

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '15'.

exercises.instructionEn: Form: One-syllable adjectives add -(e)r/-(e)st: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest. One-syllable adjectives ending in one stressed vowel between two consonants double the last consonant: big - bigger - the biggest. Two-syllable adjectives ending in a consonant + -y drop -y and add -ier/-iest: heavy - heavier - the heaviest. Adjectives of two or more syllables take more/most: careful - more careful - the most careful. Irregular adjectives have their own individual forms. Note: We often make comparisons using than. We use the before the superlative form.
exercises.instructionUz: Shakl: Bir bo'g'inli sifatlar -(e)r/-(e)st oladi: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest. Ikki undosh orasida bitta urg'uli unli bilan tugaydigan bir bo'g'inli sifatlarda oxirgi undosh ikkilanadi: big - bigger - the biggest. Undosh + -y bilan tugaydigan ikki bo'g'inli sifatlar -y ni tashlab -ier/-iest oladi: heavy - heavier - the heaviest. Ikki va undan ko'p bo'g'inli sifatlar more/most oladi: careful - more careful - the most careful. Noto'g'ri sifatlarning o'z shakllari bor. Eslatma: Qiyoslashda ko'pincha 'than' ishlatiladi. Orttirma darajadan oldin 'the' keladi.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYOSLASh ShAKLI - IMLO.

  1) BIR BO'G'INLI: + -er / -est
     cheap → cheaper → the cheapest
     large → largER → the largEST
     (-e bor: faqat -r / -st)

  2) UNDOSh + UNLI + UNDOSh:
     ikkilanadi
     big → biGGer → the biGGest
     hot → hoTTer → the hoTTest

  3) UNDOSh + -y: -y → -ier / -iest
     heavy → heavIER → the heavIEST
     easy → easier → the easiest

  4) IKKI+ BO'G'INLI: more / the
     most
     careful → MORE careful → THE
     MOST careful

  5) NOTO'G'RI: good/better/best
     ...


ESLATMA:

  Qiyosiy + THAN: bigger THAN
  Orttirma + THE: THE biggest
  Orttirma + OF / IN: the biggest
  IN the world / OF all

points.en: large - larger (than) - the largest (of/in); cheap - cheaper - the cheapest
big - bigger - the biggest (double the last consonant)
careful - more careful - the most careful (two or more syllables)

exercises.instructionEn: Use: We use the comparative form to compare two people, things, places, etc. We usually use than: Sue's skirt is longer than Mary's. We use the superlative form to compare a person, thing or place with the whole group they belong to. We use the ... of/in: Pluto is the coldest planet in our solar system. We use (not) as + adjective + as to say that two people, things or places are/are not similar: Tom is as tall as Peter. We use less + adjective + than: The green jacket is less expensive than the yellow jacket. We use much + comparative form + than: This tie is much longer than that one.
exercises.instructionUz: Ishlatilishi: Qiyosiy daraja IKKI odam, narsa, joyni solishtiradi, odatda 'than' bilan: Syuning yubkasi Merinikidan uzunroq. Orttirma daraja bitta odam/narsa/joyni BUTUN GURUH bilan solishtiradi, the ... of/in bilan: Pluton quyosh tizimimizdagi eng sovuq sayyora. (not) as + sifat + as - ikki narsa o'xshash/o'xshash emasligini bildiradi: Tom Piter bilan bir xil bo'yda. less + sifat + than: Yashil kurtka sariq kurtkadan kamroq qimmat. much + qiyosiy + than: Bu galstuk anavinisidan ANChA uzun.
exercises.explanationUz:
QIYOSLASh - 5 XIL QOLIP.

  1) QIYOSIY + THAN (ikki narsa):
     Sue's skirt is LONGER THAN
     Mary's.

  2) THE + ORTTIRMA + OF/IN (butun
     guruh):
     Pluto is THE COLDEST planet IN
     our solar system.

  3) (NOT) AS + SIFAT + AS (bir
     xil / bir xil emas):
     Tom is AS TALL AS Peter.
     Peter is NOT AS TALL AS Sally.

  4) LESS + SIFAT + THAN (kamroq):
     The green jacket is LESS
     EXPENSIVE THAN the yellow one.

  5) MUCH + QIYOSIY + THAN (ancha):
     This tie is MUCH LONGER THAN
     that one.


⚠ 'MARY'S' = Mary's skirt:

  Takrorlamaslik uchun egalik
  shakli yolg'iz qoladi.

points.en: Sue's skirt is longer than Mary's. (comparative + than: two things)
Pluto is the coldest planet in our solar system. (superlative: whole group)

points.en: Tom is as tall as Peter. ((not) as ... as: similar / not similar)
points.uz: Tom Piter bilan bir xil bo'yda. (o'xshash)

points.en: The green jacket is less expensive than the yellow jacket. (less + adjective + than)
points.uz: Yashil kurtka sariq kurtkadan kamroq qimmat. (kamroq)

points.en: This tie is much longer than that one. (much + comparative + than)

exercises.instructionEn: We use must + infinitive without to to say that something is logically true: They look the same. They must be twins. We use can't + infinitive without to to say that something is logically untrue: This book can't be his. He doesn't like detective stories.
exercises.instructionUz: Must + to siz infinitiv - biror narsa mantiqan to'g'ri ekanini bildiradi: Ular bir xil ko'rinadi. Ular egizak bo'lsa kerak. Can't + to siz infinitiv - biror narsa mantiqan noto'g'ri ekanini bildiradi: Bu kitob uniki bo'lishi mumkin emas. U detektiv hikoyalarni yoqtirmaydi.
exercises.explanationUz:
IShONChLI TAXMIN - MUST / CAN'T.

  MUST + fe'l = bo'lsa kerak
    (mantiqan TO'G'RI - dalil bor)
    They look the same. They MUST
    BE twins.

  CAN'T + fe'l = bo'lishi mumkin
    emas (mantiqan NOTO'G'RI)
    This book CAN'T BE his. He
    doesn't like detective stories.

  ⚠ Bu yerda 'must' - majburiyat
  EMAS, taxmin. 'can't' -
  qobiliyat EMAS, taxmin.

  ⚠ Inkori 'mustn't' EMAS - 'can't'!
  (mustn't = taqiq)

points.en: They look the same. They must be twins. (logically true)
points.uz: Ular bir xil ko'rinadi. Ular egizak bo'lsa kerak. (mantiqan to'g'ri)

points.en: This book can't be his. He doesn't like detective stories. (logically untrue)
points.uz: Bu kitob uniki bo'lishi mumkin emas. U detektiv hikoyalarni yoqtirmaydi. (mantiqan noto'g'ri)

exercises.instructionEn: We use will + infinitive without to to make predictions based on what we believe or think. We usually use will with the verbs think and expect, and the adverb probably, etc: I think he will help me.
exercises.instructionUz: Will + to siz infinitiv - ishonch yoki fikrga asoslangan bashorat uchun. Odatda think, expect fe'llari va probably ravishi bilan: Menimcha, u menga yordam beradi.
exercises.explanationUz:
WILL - BAShORAT (fikrga
  asoslangan).

  I THINK he WILL help me.
  I EXPECT it will rain.
  He will PROBABLY come.

  Belgi so'zlar: think, expect,
  probably, I'm sure, perhaps.

  ⚠ will + fe'l ASOSIY shakli
  (will to help ✗, will helps ✗).
  ⚠ Qisqa: I'll, he'll; inkor:
  won't.

points.en: I think he will help me. (prediction based on what we think)
points.uz: Menimcha, u menga yordam beradi. (fikrga asoslangan bashorat)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with the correct form of the adjectives in brackets, as in the example.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni qavsdagi sifatlarning to'g'ri shakli bilan to'ldiring, namunadagidek.
exercises.explanationUz:
QOLIPGA QARAB ShAKL TANLASh.

  ... than → qiyosiy
  the ... in/ever → orttirma
  as ... as / less ... than / very
    ... → ODDIY shakl (o'zgarmaydi!)
  much ... than → qiyosiy

  1 bigger (NAMUNA)
  2 as TALL as (oddiy)
  3 MORE POLLUTED than (uzun)
  4 the WORST (noto'g'ri; 'I've
    ever eaten')
  5 less MODERN than (oddiy)
  6 very FAMOUS (oddiy)
  7 as RICH as (oddiy)
  8 the MOST BEAUTIFUL (uzun)
  9 MORE COMFORTABLE than
  10 MORE EXPENSIVE than
  11 much CHEAPER than
  12 the LARGEST (-e bor)


⚠ 'POLLUTED':

  = ifloslangan.


⚠ 'THE DANUBE':

  = Dunay daryosi.
